titleLine2: making sure the child truly understands.
description: A simple experience: Amauta detects, explains and shows progress — so learning at home stops being a struggle.
mascotAlt: Amauta showing how the app works

1.label: Diagnosis
1.title: Detects exactly where they are
1.description: A short, friendly activity determines the real starting point: what they master, what's hard and where to begin — without stressful tests.

2.label: Guided practice
2.title: Explains, accompanies and adjusts
2.description: Amauta explains with examples, accompanies every attempt and adjusts the difficulty so the child never gets stuck.

3.label: Visible progress
3.title: You know how they're doing, no expert needed
3.description: Immediate feedback for the child and a clear report for home: what improved and how to keep going this week.
